title: Portainer SSO with Casdoor: OAuth Setup Guide
headline: Single sign-on for Portainer
summary: Portainer's custom OAuth provider works with Casdoor's OAuth 2.0 endpoints, so people manage containers with their Casdoor account instead of a separate Portainer password.

steps.title: Configure OAuth in Portainer
steps.text: In Portainer, open **Settings → Authentication**, choose **OAuth**, turn on **Use SSO** and **Automatic user provisioning**, pick the **Custom** provider and fill in:

steps.title: Sign in
steps.text: Save and log out. The Portainer login page now has a **Login with OAuth** button that sends users to Casdoor.

tips: New users created by automatic provisioning have no access until you add them to a team or give them access to an environment.
The Redirect URL in Portainer and in Casdoor must be the address people open Portainer at, exactly.

faqs.question: Can Casdoor groups become Portainer teams?
faqs.answer: Mapping OAuth groups to Portainer teams is a Portainer Business Edition feature. In the Community Edition, assign users to teams in Portainer.

faqs.question: Why preferred_username as the user identifier?
faqs.answer: It is the Casdoor username in the userinfo response, so Portainer usernames match Casdoor's. You can use `email` instead if you prefer.
